literal: Through good conduct they will attain greatness; through lapse in conduct they will attain inescapable blame.
translation: Through good conduct, people attain greatness. Through a lapse in conduct, they attain inescapable disgrace.
modern: நல்லொழுக்கத்தால் மனிதர்கள் மேன்மையை அடைவார்கள். ஒழுக்கம் தவறுவதால் அவர்கள் நீங்காத பழியை அடைவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the outcomes of maintaining and losing one's good conduct. The word 'ஒழுக்கம்' (good conduct) leads naturally to 'மேன்மை' (greatness or excellence). Conversely, 'இழுக்கம்' (a lapse or failure in conduct) results in 'எய்தாப் பழி', which means inescapable or unprecedented disgrace. The parallel structure emphasizes that just as surely as discipline brings honor, its absence guarantees lasting blame.
